name: upload
description: Represents a file upload or send-to-cloud action. On hover, the arrow fires upward into a portal clip via a conveyor belt mechanism: the primary arrow exits the top while a clone rises seamlessly from below to take its place. The tray base stays static. Reverses on hover-leave.

animation.description: Hold-to-loop sending: while hovered, the conveyor repeats (0.45s per cycle) so arrows ride upward one after another. Looping is justified because an upload affordance is a transfer/progress indicator. Press, focus, or manual trigger plays a single cycle. Leave stops the loop and resets to rest. Two identical arrow paths stacked 16 SVG units apart share a motion.g. Unique per-instance clipPath IDs via useId() prevent DOM conflicts. Reduced motion: static.

accessibility.notes: When used as a file upload trigger, pair with a visible label or progress indicator after activation.
